AmbassadorProfile.title: AmbassadorProfile
AmbassadorProfile.description: Kingdom Ambassador Committee member profile stored per authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: Full display name of the committee member.

roleTitle.description: Committee title shown in header and profile.

bio.description: Short campus ministry testimony or focus.

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google account.

officeLine.description: Member contact number updated in their own profile.

accessRole.description: Invitation role used to register (Student/Alumni or Admin).

accountTag.description: Unique Google account identifier ensuring one registration per account.

isOnline.description: Whether the member is currently logged in and online.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

PrivateContactInfo.title: PrivateContactInfo
PrivateContactInfo.description: Isolated private PII contact and notification preferences for a user.

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether weekly worship and task notifications are enabled.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when private settings were updated.

grantedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

AdvisoryRosterMeta.title: AdvisoryRosterMeta
AdvisoryRosterMeta.description: Bounded list of active Advisory Council document IDs for live synchronization.

updatedByUid.description: Admin UID that last updated the roster.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when roster was updated.

AdvisorEntry.title: AdvisorEntry
AdvisorEntry.description: Publicly visible Advisory Council profile managed by Committee Admins.

details.description: Advisor biography and ministry details (max 700 words / 5000 chars).

photoUrl.description: Uploaded advisor portrait image (Data URL or URL).

updatedByUid.description: UID of the Admin who created or updated this advisor.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when advisor was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when advisor was last updated.

EventRosterMeta.title: EventRosterMeta
EventRosterMeta.description: Bounded list of active Event document IDs for live synchronization across Public, Student/Alumni, and Admin views.

updatedByUid.description: Admin UID that last updated the event roster.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when event roster was updated.

EventEntry.title: EventEntry
EventEntry.description: Publicly visible Kingdom Ambassador Event with 1:1 poster image managed by Committee Admins.

fullDate.description: Formatted date or date range displayed under the 1:1 poster.

imageUrl.description: 1:1 square event poster image URL or compressed Data URL.

isFeaturedMeeting.description: Whether this event is featured on the Overview card.

attendeesJson.description: Serialized JSON array of attendee badges.

agendaJson.description: Serialized JSON array of agenda items.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the Admin who created or updated this event.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when event was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when event was last updated.

DashboardSyncState.title: DashboardSyncState
DashboardSyncState.description: Live synchronized state for Announcements, Committee Directory, and Tasks updated by Admins.

announcementsJson.description: Serialized JSON array of CommitteeAnnouncement items.

membersJson.description: Serialized JSON array of CommitteeMember items.

tasksJson.description: Serialized JSON array of CommitteeTask items.

updatedByUid.description: Admin UID that last updated the dashboard sync state.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when dashboard sync state was updated.

CommitteeRosterMeta.title: CommitteeRosterMeta
CommitteeRosterMeta.description: Live roster of auto-registered Committee Member UIDs and Admin-deleted UIDs.

memberUids.description: Ordered list of registered committee member UIDs (max 50).

deletedUids.description: List of UIDs removed by Admin (max 50).

updatedByUid.description: UID of the user or Admin who updated the roster.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the committee roster was updated.

InvitationCodesMeta.title: InvitationCodesMeta
InvitationCodesMeta.description: Admin-managed invitation codes for Student/Alumni (SA) and Admin access.

invitationsJson.description: Serialized JSON array of invitation objects with code and role (Student/Alumni or Admin).

updatedByUid.description: Admin UID that last updated the invitation codes.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when invitation codes were updated.

/profiles/{userId}.description: Stores the Kingdom Ambassador Committee profile document for each authenticated user, self-editable only by the owner and readable in the Committee Directory.

/profiles/{userId}/private/{infoId}.description: Stores isolated private email and notification settings strictly accessible only by the profile owner.

/admins/{userId}.description: Stores verified Admin UIDs authorized to create and update Advisory Council, Events, Invitations, and Dashboard records.

/advisory_meta/{metaId}.description: Stores the singleton roster index document (metaId == 'roster') listing active advisor IDs for live updates.

/advisors/{advisorId}.description: Stores individual Advisory Council member profiles readable by public, Student/Alumni, and Admin users, and writable only by Admins.

/event_meta/{metaId}.description: Stores the singleton roster index document (metaId == 'roster') listing active event IDs for live updates.

/events/{eventId}.description: Stores individual Kingdom Ambassador Events with 1:1 posters readable by public, Student/Alumni, and Admin users, and writable only by Admins.

/dashboard_sync/{stateId}.description: Stores the singleton live dashboard state (stateId == 'public_board') for Announcements, Committee Members, and Tasks updated by Admins.

/committee_meta/{metaId}.description: Stores the singleton committee roster index (metaId == 'roster') of logged-in users registered via invitation codes.

/invitation_meta/{metaId}.description: Stores the singleton invitation codes registry (metaId == 'codes') managed strictly by Admins for SA and Admin invitations.
